معدات:Oil Pump for 
 sediments
 1K-6
 USSR
مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I2, which must be performed on annual bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block

المواصفات الفنية لمضخة الزيت : 
السعة Q:1.6-3.91/s، إجمالي الرأس H: 14-20m، السرعة n:2900 دورة في الدقيقة، الطاقة: 1.7 كيلو واط

The pump 
function is to withdraw the oil residue from oil tanks.
The first draft is initiated by Ahmed Hassan Ragab, reviewed by eng. Ahmed Saber 
Gabr, 
accepted by Pre.general director eng. Ahmed Saber 
Gabr, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector of High Dam 
Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.

This document certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS Hyd.EPCo. Coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير 
 مطلوب المحيطة بمنطقة العمل.
Wear safety equipment as safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc
Switch off Pump
Use suitable warning boards

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

لإجراء الفحص الخارجي وسماع صوت المضخة 
 التشغيل قبل التوقف للمراجعة لغرض التشغيل العادي 
 من المحامل والاهتزازات والتسرب من خلال وصلات الختم

When stripping a pump, inspect all the parts as to determine 
 whether individual parts are fit for further service, whether they should be 
 replaced or subjected to repair
Begin stripping a pump by detaching the pipe line
Remove the pump housing cover & the impeller
Strip the sealing gland
Remove the pump housing from its bracket

قم بخلع أغطية مبيت المحمل عن طريق الانجراف 
 محمل كروي ورمح
Take the ball bearing off the pump shaft

Having inspected, repair or replaced parts, as required, begin 
 assembly of the pump in reverse steps of stripping
Before assembly, flush all parts and wipe them dry

Having assembled the pump, back grease into the ball bearing 
 housing
Run the pump and check for the proper operation
